Primary metabolic pathways underlying exogenous H₂S-mediated salt stress responses in R

Primary metabolic pathways underlying exogenous H₂S-mediated salt stress responses in R. soongorica roots. The main metabolic pathways of R. soongorica roots under different treatments: (A) arginine and proline metabolism and (B) starch and sucrose metabolism
